gaps.statement: No method in the provided corpus targets low-light enhancement for underwater imaging environments.

exclusion_evidence.scope_description: Provided corpus of 15 low-light image enhancement records (2015-2024), screened via q1 (full-corpus triage) and q2 (detection-utility rescreen); no external database search was executed.

near_misses.why_not: Targets infrared-visible fusion for nighttime surveillance, a terrestrial setting; underwater imaging is not addressed.
Handles nighttime street images only; no underwater or other non-terrestrial imaging environment.

gaps.statement: Whether low-light enhancement reliably improves downstream object detection remains an unresolved conflict in the corpus.

exclusion_evidence.scope_description: Provided corpus of 15 low-light image enhancement records (2015-2024), screened via q1 and q2; q2 specifically re-screened all corpus records mentioning downstream detection.

near_misses.why_not: Reports a positive effect (+4.2 mAP) but is only one side of the conflict; it does not resolve the question.
Reports no significant effect (-0.3 mAP), the opposite side; the two records disagree, leaving the question unresolved.
